Inspirational Scripture Bookmarks, Set of 5 Floral Bible Verse Printables, Faith Encouragement Gift for Christian Women | Faith Filled Floral Bookmarks | Turn Every Page with Faith and Encouragement
Five Inspiring Reminders to Trust God and Hold His Promises Close
Let every page bring your heart back to God’s Word. This set of 5 Printable Scripture Bookmarks pairs meaningful Bible verses with beautiful floral artwork, offering daily encouragement whenever you open your Bible, devotional, journal, or favorite book.
Each bookmark is 2×7 inches, and the complete collection is arranged on A4 and US Letter printable sheets. These bookmarks are perfect for personal devotion, encouragement gifts, care packages, Bible study friends, Christian women, and anyone who needs a gentle reminder of faith and hope.
Instant digital download for craft projects, Christian Church activities, prayer journals.

 This is a printable digital download. No physical items will be shipped. You can print these images as many times as you need.

 – Fits standard paper size US letter/ A4 when printing.
 – one side
 – They are all the same layer and CANNOT BE EDITABLE!
 – High resolution 300dpi for the finest printing results.
PLEASE NOTE:
 – Colors may vary slightly depending on the monitor.
INSTANT DOWNLOAD:
 You can print these designs unlimited times. Moreover, you can use it to be a digital decor paper with your digital planner too!
Download, print, cut, and keep God’s promises close—or share the set with someone who needs encouragement today.
Digital download only. No physical item will be shipped.
